title: Farey Symbols for the Picard Group
summary: We develop Picard Farey symbols for finite-index subgroups of \(G=\PSL_2(\ZZ[i])\) from the Gaussian Farey tessellation of \(\HH^3\) by ideal octahedra. The ambient geometry naturally involves two different index-two extensions of \(G\): the orientation-preserving group \(\PGL_2(\ZZ[i])\) and a reflection extension. This distinction explains the two \(G\)-orbits of Farey faces, which merge into one \(\PGL_2\)-orbit, and the classical extended modular tessellation appears as a totally geodesic slice.
